title: Cosmetics Catalogue
summary: Every cosmetic confirmed in the network's current configuration: hats, back/body cosmetics and off-hand items, made at the crafting altar (see the Cosmetics & Crafting Altar system). Despite the filename, these are network-wide items - anything crafted on one server can be worn on any of them. Two are exclusive to Diamond Trophy's own materials, and one (Headphones) is not craftable at all and only comes from a Rare Crate. Several are animated.
how_to_access: Craft most of these at the crafting altar (right-click the furniture, or /altar for MVIP+). Equip owned hats and body cosmetics from the profile menu's Cosmetics button (/cosmetics) or the in-world wardrobe; pick an off-hand cosmetic with /offhand.

entries.name: Golden Crown
entries.description: An ornate golden crown that floats just above your head, bobbing gently and slowly turning.
entries.how_to_get: Craft at the altar once a Legendary Hat Blueprint (a rare Rare Crate find) has opened the recipe. The craft needs a very large amount of common gathering material plus leather, forged steel, and a small amount of two rarer crafting dusts, and also costs a sizeable chunk of network coins.
entries.how_to_use: Once crafted, equip it from the Cosmetics menu. Animated: floats, bobs and spins above the head.
entries.icon_hint: an ornate golden crown with small jewels
entries.notes: Legendary rarity; roughly a 12-hour craft. Real model: rc_cosmetics crown_hat; the worn version is a ModelEngine model.

entries.name: Headphones
entries.description: A pair of over-ear headphones worn as a hat. They pulse as if music were playing, and a music note drifts up from your head now and then.
entries.how_to_get: Not craftable at the altar at all - the only confirmed way to get this is a rare pull from a Rare Crate's chase rewards.
entries.how_to_use: Equip from the Cosmetics menu once owned. Animated.
entries.icon_hint: purple over-ear headphones worn like a hat, no visible cable
entries.notes: No rarity tier is shown for it in the current configuration, so none is listed here.

entries.name: Top Hat
entries.description: A tall, formal top hat with two loose feathers that sway in the wind. Flavor text calls it dressing up "for formal parkour."
entries.how_to_get: Craft at the altar (needs a solid amount of common gathering material, some leather, and a little glass shard material), OR get it directly, already finished, as one of the guaranteed "chase" roll outcomes when opening a Rare Crate.
entries.how_to_use: Equip from the Cosmetics menu once owned. Animated: the feathers sway.
entries.icon_hint: a sky-blue silk top hat with a thin band and two hanging feathers

entries.name: Pumpkin Hat
entries.description: A carved pumpkin worn as a hat, its spilling insides slowly bobbing up and down. Joked about as "seasonal, in the sense that you decide the season."
entries.how_to_get: Craft at the altar (needs a modest amount of common gathering material and a little of the "warm" crafting powder), OR get it directly, already finished, as one of the possible outcomes of a Common Crate's bonus "chase" roll.
entries.how_to_use: Equip from the Cosmetics menu once owned. Animated.
entries.icon_hint: a carved jack-o'-lantern pumpkin worn as a hat, orange with a green stem

entries.name: Goblin Crown
entries.description: A crude crown described as "taken from a goblin who was not using it."
entries.how_to_get: Craft at the altar using goblin-skin material (a Diamond Trophy monster drop) plus common gathering material and a moderate amount of network coins.
entries.how_to_use: Equip from the Cosmetics menu once owned; worn in the helmet slot.
entries.icon_hint: a rough, slightly crooked golden crown with a scavenged look
entries.notes: Rare rarity. Not animated. Its materials only drop on Diamond Trophy, but like every cosmetic here it can be worn on any server once you own it.

entries.name: Orange Bucket
entries.description: A plain orange plastic bucket, worn tilted on the head. Described in the altar's own recipe notes as "nobody asked for this. You found it anyway."
entries.how_to_get: Craft at the altar using only Orange Plastic - an extremely rare Diamond Trophy easter-egg material (a small chance from smashing pots, or a rarer boss drop). The recipe itself needs very few of it.
entries.how_to_use: Equip from the Cosmetics menu once owned; worn in the helmet slot.
entries.icon_hint: a plain orange plastic bucket worn tilted as a hat
entries.notes: Marked Legendary rarity despite the tiny recipe - the joke is that Orange Plastic itself is the hard part to find. Not animated. Materials are Diamond Trophy-exclusive; the cosmetic can still be worn anywhere.

entries.name: Jetpack
entries.description: A back-mounted jetpack that shakes as if running and flares fire and smoke out of the back for a moment whenever you jump. Described as "does not actually fly. Looks like it might."
entries.how_to_get: Craft at the altar once an Epic Body Blueprint (drops from a Rare Crate) has opened the recipe. Needs a large amount of common gathering material, the "warm" crafting powder, forged steel, a little of the rarer rainbow powder, and a chunk of network coins.
entries.how_to_use: Equip from the Cosmetics menu once owned; renders on your back. Animated.
entries.icon_hint: a chunky metal jetpack with two tanks and small exhausts

entries.name: Angel Wings
entries.description: A full pair of feathered angel wings that float and gently flap, described simply as "the long one. Worth it."
entries.how_to_get: Craft at the altar once a Mythic Wings Blueprint (a very rare Rare Crate find) has opened the recipe. The recipe needs a very large amount of common gathering material, several rarer crafting materials including luck essence and star dust, and the largest coin cost of any cosmetic recipe currently configured.
entries.how_to_use: Equip from the Cosmetics menu once owned; renders on your back. Animated.
entries.icon_hint: a full pair of large white feathered angel wings

entries.name: Bouquet
entries.description: A small bouquet of three roses, held in the off hand, swaying a little as if in a breeze. Described as "someone was thinking of you."
entries.how_to_get: Craft at the altar using a modest amount of common gathering material plus a little leather, OR get it directly as one of the possible outcomes of a Common Crate's bonus "chase" roll.
entries.how_to_use: Pick it with /offhand. Shown only while your off hand is empty. Animated.
entries.icon_hint: a small hand-held bouquet of roses wrapped in paper
entries.notes: Uncommon rarity. Off-hand cosmetics are switched off on Diamond Trophy.

entries.name: Lantern
entries.description: A lit lantern, held in the off hand, with little sparks that drift around it and blink in and out. Described as "warm, and slightly smug about it."
entries.how_to_get: Craft at the altar using a solid amount of common gathering material, the "warm" crafting powder, and a little glow-powder material, OR get it directly as one of the guaranteed "chase" roll outcomes of a Rare Crate.
entries.how_to_use: Pick it with /offhand. Shown only while your off hand is empty. Animated.
entries.icon_hint: a small lit lantern with drifting sparks, held out in one hand
entries.notes: Rare rarity. Off-hand cosmetics are switched off on Diamond Trophy.

open_questions: Four cosmetics that existed as placeholders before this update (Turtle Shell, Cannon Pack, Blue Balloon, Plush) are not obtainable right now - no recipe, no crate and no wardrobe entry - until they have models. They are expected back; nothing about their eventual cost is decided.
Headphones has no listed rarity tier in configuration.
The icon files in assets/icons/hub-cosmetics/ predate the real models and may not match the new art.
